summary: Sandbox supplies the enforceable isolation and capability boundary inside the broader YOLO with Rails operating recipe.

items.text: Compose isolation with YOLO with Rails so bounded authority is joined by explicit budgets, deterministic checks and an artifact-first review hand-off.
Contain the effects of action proposals influenced by untrusted content; instruction–data separation governs interpretation, while Sandbox enforces the available capabilities.
Enforce the filesystem, process and network rights declared by the Agent–Computer Interface; the tool contract describes authority but does not create it.
See Agent Fencing for the related use case or counterpoint: The platform owns the durable history; agents receive bounded authority and oversight proportional to trust and risk.
